Women again outnumber men in IIM Indore's MBA program

For the second consecutive year, women have outnumbered men in the flagship MBA batch at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore. This trend highlights a continuing shift in gender representation within the institution's premier business program. The development suggests a growing female presence in management education at one of India's leading business schools.
